prompts.prompt: Create ONE professional grayscale equipment illustration for a concert stage plot: a recognizable Fender Telecaster electric guitar resting upright on a neat black three-leg guitar stand. View from a HIGH CAMERA ANGLE about 65 degrees above the floor, looking down from in front: show the guitar's top/front face with natural foreshortening, not straight eye-level and not a pure plan view. Neck points toward the top of the image, body near bottom, no rotation sideways. Accurate single-cutaway Telecaster silhouette, light gray body, black pickguard, simple chrome bridge, six inline tuning pegs. Stand is structurally believable, clean straight legs and cradles, subtly behind the guitar. Style: polished product illustration, precise smooth contours, restrained neutral-gray shading, crisp black outlines and broad uncluttered shapes; like a professionally rendered technical-rider equipment cutout. It must remain instantly recognizable at about 0.6 inch tall in a black-and-white printout. Simplify strings, frets and controls, omit tiny branding and texture. Transparent background with real alpha; no ground plane, no cast shadow outside the object, no glow, no checkerboard, no text, no badge. Full object and all stand feet visible with small padding. Do not make it sketchy, wobbly, cartoon doodled, or crudely hand-drawn.

Create ONE professional grayscale equipment illustration for a concert stage plot: a recognizable Fender Mustang short-scale electric BASS, four strings, resting upright on a neat black three-leg guitar stand. View from a HIGH CAMERA ANGLE about 65 degrees above the floor, looking down from in front: show the instrument's top/front face with natural foreshortening, not straight eye-level and not a pure plan view. Neck points toward the top of the image, body near bottom, no sideways rotation. Accurate compact offset double-cutaway Mustang BASS body, medium-gray body, pale white pickguard, one split bass pickup, simple chrome bridge, four inline tuning pegs. Stand is structurally believable with clean straight legs and cradles, subtly behind the bass. Style: polished product illustration, precise smooth contours, restrained neutral-gray shading, crisp black outlines and broad uncluttered shapes; like a professionally rendered technical-rider equipment cutout. It must remain instantly recognizable at about 0.64 inch tall in a black-and-white printout. Simplify strings, frets and controls, omit tiny branding and texture. Transparent background with real alpha; no ground plane, no cast shadow outside the object, no glow, no checkerboard, no text, no badge. Full instrument and all stand feet visible with small padding. Do not make it sketchy, wobbly, cartoon doodled, or crudely hand-drawn.

Create ONE professional grayscale equipment illustration for a concert stage plot: a wireless IN-EAR MONITOR BODY-PACK RECEIVER, recognizable professional PSM-style black beltpack receiver, viewed from high camera angle looking down slightly at its front/top. Simple tidy rectangular body with subtly rounded corners, small blank LCD near the top, a short straight antenna extending from one upper corner and a small volume knob on the top. Include a single neatly arranged curved thin earphone cable leading to TWO small in-ear earpieces beside the pack; keep the cable short and contained, not a huge tangled coil. On the receiver's lower FRONT face place a large clean circular WHITE sticker with a perfectly centered bold BLACK number '1'. The circle and number must be large and legible at 0.4 inch total icon height. Style: polished product illustration, precise smooth contours, restrained neutral-gray shading, crisp black outlines and broad uncluttered shapes; like a professionally rendered technical-rider equipment cutout. Simplify all controls. No branding, no other labels. Transparent background with real alpha; no ground plane, no cast shadow outside the object, no glow, no checkerboard. Full pack, antenna and earphones visible with small padding. Do not make it sketchy, wobbly, cartoon doodled, or crudely hand-drawn.
